articles.title: Trump's Iran pledge underpins crypto gains as bitcoin bears face liquidation pressure
Bitcoin steadies near $82,500 after Trump rules out Iran strike before midterms
articles.snippet: Bitcoin recovered to around $82,500 after Trump ruled out an Iran strike, but remains about 4% lower on the week, while ether has lost 9%.

articles.title: Trump administration outlines quantum, AI initiatives in $6B science push
articles.snippet: The White House outlined a $215 million quantum computing competition and $2.4 billion in AI industry commitments as concerns grow over quantum threats to cryptocurrency security.
